text:
deploybot: initiating pin request rb-5943211111 -> runtime-3.4 (models: llama3q-quant). state=STARTED :rocket:

nina.engineer: canaries in ap-south are failing longseq warmups, saw repeated 'kv_seg_alloc failed' after applying runtime-3.4 image. pin stuck at ~28%.

samops: saw same in staging earlier, likely kvcache allocator behavioral change. recommended temp-routing fallback instead of abrupt cancel.

leo.sre: telemetry: error-rate spike to 6.8% and p95 latency up 220ms. propose: 1) add routing rule to steer llama3q-quant -> runtime-3.2 for 45m, 2) keep pin drain but pause further placement, 3) gather heap/core dumps.

product-oncall: agree on minimal customer impact. I'll prepare a short support note and standby with support team.

nina.engineer: applying route now:
```
/routes apply --scope model:llama3q-quant --from runtime-3.4 --to runtime-3.2 --duration 2700 --reason "kvcache allocator regressions" --force
```

samops: route applied, change_id=rout-5943211112, ~7.1k requests rerouted.

deploybot: routing rule active. pin continued in drain but excluded affected pool from new placements.

samops: quick metrics: error-rate dropped to 1.1% in 90s, median latency improved ~150ms.

leo.sre: we'll run extended warmups and a targeted smoke for longseq in staging. if stable after 45m we can either rollback the pin or prepare a shim patch for allocator.

nina.engineer: adding compat-flag in pinlist for kvcache-hotpath models and PR for pre-pin longseq smoke. will also add temporary annotation exclude:model=llama3q-quant to prevent auto-repin.

product-oncall: thanks. marking this thread monitored; reopen if error-rate crosses 5% or if rout TTL expires with regressions. :white_check_mark:
